name: residual-causes
description: Name the causes of a pixel residual after the iteration cap — multi-label, one noul per cause, from instrument output that code has already bucketed into words (#126).

fields.verdict: { pct, heightDelta, bands: ['y 0-500: 23 % hot', ...], anchors: ['section 4 (hero) is 48 px taller on the build', ...], chrome: 'header 1.2 % footer 4.4 %', notes: 'capture and instrument notes' }

font_fallback.instructions: Does `verdict` indicate a different typeface or font weight on the build than on the origin — a substitute face, thin glyph-edge noise across text-dense bands, differing line wraps?

nondeterministic_live.instructions: Does `verdict` indicate content that varies between loads of the origin — a carousel on another slide, a rotating rail, personalised or A/B content, a ticker or date?

sticky_widget.instructions: Does `verdict` indicate a fixed or sticky third-party widget (chat, feedback tab, cookie bar, back-to-top) present on one side only?

capture_truncation.instructions: Does `verdict` indicate the capture itself failed — a truncated or wrapped screenshot, an unsettled page, a blocked or challenged origin, a missing image?

chrome_generation.instructions: Does `verdict` indicate the header or footer geometry differs — a different height, a second chrome generation, a nav row or strip missing or added?

pipeline_transform.instructions: Does `verdict` indicate a delivery-pipeline transformation — wrapped pictures, unwrapped paragraphs, an empty metadata section adding padding, rewritten media paths?

offset_contamination.instructions: Does `verdict` indicate that bands below the first hot band are off only because everything above shifted them?

unexplained.instructions: Is there a residual in `verdict` that none of these explains: font, live variation, sticky widget, capture failure, chrome geometry, pipeline transform, offset contamination?
